rows.text: makes the call at `00799B20` + 0x17 with `ecx` = 0x28 and, when it returns null, makes the indirect call at + 0x26; then stores the returned block's own address in its qwords `+0`, `+8` and `+0x10` (the last two each behind a non-null test of the slot address), stores word 0x101 at `+0x18`, and returns the block

notes: 00799B20: the indirect call at + 0x26 goes through a pointer slot outside the body (not named, cited by site). The listing has no code after it that handles a return from it: execution would fall through to the stores with rax as that call left it.
